subject: surgical-technology
intro: Surgical technology leads into the operating room team — the scrubs who guard the sterile field and pass the instruments, the first assistants at the table, and the sterile-processing staff behind every tray.

roles.title: Surgical Technologists
roles.what: Assist in operations under the supervision of surgeons and nurses: set up the operating room, prepare and transport patients, pass instruments and supplies, hold retractors and help count sponges, needles and instruments.
roles.where: The CST units are the job description — asepsis and the sterile field, instrumentation and supplies, the surgical count and safety, and the scrub role from unit 4's intraoperative practice.

roles.title: Surgical Assistants
roles.what: Assist surgeons at the table: helping with incisions and closures, manipulating tissue, implanting devices, suctioning, clamping vessels and applying dressings, under state laws governing the role.
roles.where: Unit 4's anticipating the surgeon and unit 5's procedures across general, orthopaedic, cardiothoracic and neurosurgery give the anatomy and flow awareness the first-assistant role advances from.

roles.title: Medical Equipment Preparers
roles.what: Prepare, sterilise, install and clean laboratory and healthcare equipment, building and checking the instrument trays that surgery depends on arriving sterile and complete.
roles.where: Unit 1's microbiology for surgery and sterilisation methods, and unit 2's instrument categories and care, are the sterile-processing department's whole discipline.
